Input image is the EDIT TARGET, a cropped piece of the existing map with 64 original-pixel overlap. Repaint the SAME complete crop at very high native resolution, about 3 times its pixel dimensions. Preserve the exact input aspect ratio and full edge-to-edge framing, no cropping, no border. Preserve every stone slab boundary, paving joint, stair tread, terrace/cliff silhouette, mountain outline, tree trunk and canopy position to within 1 original pixel. Do not redesign or shift any geometry. Preserve the original colors, light direction, exposure and material style. Increase crisp painted microdetail dramatically: separate small stone chips, fine irregular cracks WITHIN each existing stone, subtle mineral grains, engraved weathering, thin moss in existing mortar, individual maple leaves and tiny scattered fallen leaves. Keep existing mist/liquid as a painted static base in its exact shape if present. No new objects, no characters, no text or watermark. Do not invent paving seams or change the scale. Keep distant/unwalkable rock formations, red maple foliage and pink cherry blossoms in their original places. The image must align over the source when downscaled. Keep the mist at the far left and all mountain peaks and red trees, which are unwalkable scenery; improve rock striations, moss and leaf detail without changing their silhouettes.
